## Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » About Website and Join Offer
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000098610

## About Website and Join Offer
This article goes over the available settings to edit the About Website and Join Offer section on the homepage of the website. This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12139802894/original/zfDgZqM9uMkSSsDSs7QNBvARt2qlkhJ9ng.png?1709774400 | alt: ]

## 1. Hide On Mobile?
This setting controls if this section will be displayed on mobile devices or not.
No
This will show the section on mobile devices.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12139804415/original/BMB4OYiXI6EP4G8i7vDlORNTUUBh-Gp-Ig.png?1709778963 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12140007692/original/W8uuzpJF4vELxAwvzTfKB3MGIRhjplzMEg.png?1710181064 | alt: ]
Yes
This will hide the section on mobile devices
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12140000889/original/X0OrAiw0DolEOAlFprDe6aKzAd_WfAwC4A.png?1710175865 | alt: ]

## 10. Join Offer Text
This setting controls the Join Offer Text for the Join Offer module.  This module has available a Froala editor so that the message can be edited and customized according to website's needs. To learn more about the Froala editor, navigate to the following link: Everything About Froala WYSIWYG Text Editor
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12140003898/original/xs7itrIn0Z7Tn4DaG1yiAIyNgI-O5TleaQ.png?1710178044 | alt: ]

## 13. Select Link Button Color
This setting controls the Join Offer Link Button Color in the Join Offer Link module. To learn more about how to set the default button colors, navigate to the following link: Design Settings » Button Colors
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12140004620/original/iKkfFxlGyICyRDEHXntPLCEOICHWCSA28g.png?1710178610 | alt: ]

## 14. Join Offer Link URL
This setting controls the Join Offer Link URL in the Join Offer Link module. This is where people will be taken to when clicking on this call to action, this setting will only accept relative links.
